label: Delta Sync (Sync Gateway)
type: an Enterprise-Edition-only replication optimisation sending only the changed fields of a document revision rather than the whole body. Enabled per-database (delta_sync.enabled) and required to be true before an ISGR replication's own enable_delta_sync setting has any effect.
note: Stated identically on both the embedded-database and standalone-ISGR replication schemas - the same cross-schema duplication pattern as conflict_resolution_type.
